name: Neptunia CSM shadows 768x768 (25%, experimental)
description: PS5 PPSA02721 v01.000.000 only. Reduces verified cascaded shadow-map allocation dimensions from 3072x3072 to 768x768, without changing screen resolution. May significantly degrade shadow detail; monitor artifacts, driver stability and FPS. Turns off any separate host-side shadow downscale while enabled to avoid double scaling.
